query: UPDATE user_settings SET locale = COALESCE(?, locale), theme = COALESCE(?, theme), reduced_motion = IF(?, ?, reduced_motion), default_visibility = COALESCE(?, default_visibility), show_age_bracket = COALESCE(?, show_age_bracket), show_on_leaderboards = COALESCE(?, show_on_leaderboards), streak_freeze_days_per_week = COALESCE(?, streak_freeze_days_per_week) WHERE user_id = ?
